items.summary: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
items.recommend_reason_zh: dream-num/univer 是可扩展开源办公 SDK，把编辑、计算、协作、文件处理嵌入产品，面向人和 AI 代理。
items.recommend_reason_en: dream-num/univer is an open-source office SDK core for adding editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing to products for people and AI agents, making it worth opening to explore an extensible foundation for AI office tools.

items.summary: Run a team of AI agents from a pixel-art office
items.recommend_reason_zh: Pixel Office 把像素风办公室变成指挥台，让你调度一队AI代理协作完成任务，适合想直观体验多智能体运作的人打开试试。
items.recommend_reason_en: Pixel Office runs a team of AI agents from a pixel-art office, and it is worth opening to see how agent coordination is presented through a playful visual workspace.

items.summary: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
items.recommend_reason_zh: google-labs-code/stitch-skills 汇集了遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准的技能库，可配合 Stitch MCP 服务器供多种编码智能体使用，值得打开了解。
items.recommend_reason_en: google-labs-code/stitch-skills is a library of Agent Skills built for the Stitch MCP server and following the Agent Skills open standard, worth opening to see how it supports coding agents like Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.

items.summary: The open source Grok Bot alternative you actually own
items.recommend_reason_zh: Rakazo 是开源的 Grok Bot 替代品，强调你真正拥有它，想找可自主掌握的机器人替代方案值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Rakazo is an open source alternative to Grok Bot that you can own, making it worth opening if you want a self-controlled option to explore.
